title: Portals

## Portals A portal renders a child into a **different DOM node** while keeping it in the React tree (state, events, context all still work). ```jsx ReactDOM.createPortal(
I render somewhere else
, document.body ); ``` Why? CSS. A parent with `overflow: hidden` or a stacking context will clip or trap your modal. Portaling out to `document.body` escapes that. ### Your Task Build an open/close modal that portals out of the app: 1. Hold an `open` boolean state, initially `false` 2. `
